snippet.title: Vector City Racers - Promo Trailer
snippet.description:
Commissioned by Vector Entertainment, SKYSKRAPER from vimeo glued together a mixture of rich 2.5d motion graphics with some key game capture to help promote this crazy and brilliantly created online game.

Sadly this game is not online anymore, but is on sale

Go here if you want to buy it and bring it back! http://www.vectorcityracers.com/
I hope you can be able to buy it
